programme.title: Keep It Down
programme.desc: Yijun is a urologist and works alongside gynaecologist Weikang and psychotherapist Zac. They treat patients struggling with intimate conditions. As they heal others, their emotional wounds resurface. Yijun is haunted by the trauma of a flasher; Zac likes mature women who are 20 years older; and Weikang is diagnosed with testicular cancer, they slowly learn that healing begins with themselves. 一君是一名泌尿科医生，与妇科医生伟康及心理治疗师Zac一起，接诊那些有难以启齿的疾病患者。在治愈他人的过程中，他们各自的情感创伤逐渐浮现。一君仍被暴露狂事件的阴影困扰，Zac偏爱年长二十岁的成熟女性，伟康则被诊断出睾丸癌。他们也慢慢明白，真正的疗愈，始于直面自己。

programme.title: Talk of The Town
programme.desc: A half-hour talk-show segment in Hello Singapore which brings together diverse voices and expert opinions to thought-provoking discussions on wide range of issues. Incorporating online polls which gather public opinions, the segment creates a space that allows for multi viewpoints in the studio from Monday to Friday.

programme.title: Unchained Medley
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares and a plagiarism scandal, music producer Ding Yat Chun retreats to a quiet village, where he accidentally frees the spirit of a 1990s Cantonese opera star. As he helps her recover her memories and uncover the truth behind her mysterious death, friendship turns to love—while a hidden enemy will do anything to keep the past buried. 流行音乐制作人丁一骏长期饱受噩梦困扰，更卷入抄袭丑闻，遂搬到一座小村暂住散心。一次偶然，他打开村屋里的粤剧戏服旧箱，意外释放了花旦云柳芳的灵魂。柳芳原是90年代的粤剧花旦，却因意外离世，并失去了大部分生前记忆，只想寻找昔日恋人曲行云。一骏决定帮助她完成心愿，他们两阴阳相隔在相处中互相扶持，渐生情愫。然而，当有人得知柳芳的鬼魂仍在人间，担心她的死亡真相曝光，竟不惜一切代价掩盖秘密……

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Focus provides timely reports and analyses on international news and current affairs from Singapore's perspective. 《焦点》追踪国际时事，实地报道区域课题，以新加坡的视角分析时局发展的前因后果和潜在影响。

programme.title: 100% Wife
programme.desc: Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

programme.title: Brothers on the Camino
programme.desc: Pilgrimage becomes the reason to leave home and set out on a journey. Three companions walk side by side on the long-awaited pilgrimage route of their dreams, covering more than 800km and enduring the triple trials of physical strength, endurance, and spirit. programme.desc: In the former Soviet Union, a group of Estonian students go hiking in Siberia. After their unpopular leader Olle vanishes, his rival Eero leads the group to seek help, and a series of bizarre and terrifying events unfold.

programme.title: East Frisian: Rage
programme.desc: A fisherman discovers a body in the mudflats at the same time Inspector Ann Kathrin Klaasen is called to investigate a blackmail case. With the latter involving threats to poison the water supply, she begins to suspect that both cases might be connected.

programme.title: Tokyo Fianc
programme.desc: A charming and tender tale of young love and cultural discovery. Amélie, a Japanophile young Belgian woman in Tokyo falls into a whirlwind romance with Rinri, a Francophile Japanese student.

programme.title: Out Of The Blue
programme.desc: A successful and dashing young man whose life of one-night stands seems to be going great until a teenybopper, claiming to be his daughter, knocks on his door.

programme.title: Murder in Ramatuelle
programme.desc: When wine estate owner Sébastien Lacassagne is found murdered in his home, Prosecutor Elisabeth Richard and Captain Caroline Martinez delve into his tangled past. As secrets unravel, a year-old disappearance emerges as the key to unlocking the truth.

programme.title: Vanilla
programme.desc: As debt threatens to tear her family apart, eight-year-old Roberta discovers extraordinary courage in the seven fiercely different women raising her, learning that a family's greatest strength is standing together.

programme.title: Codename Holec
programme.desc: Honza films the Russian invasion of 1968 in Prague and takes the politically charged movie and actress Eva, the love of his life, on a secret trip to Vienna. There they meet a director who knows Eva very well and the Czech Secret Service even better.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: Valley of Darkness

programme.title: On The Red Dot
programme.sub-title: I Am A Hawker: Bib Gourmand Edition (Ep3): Koh Brother Pig’s Organ Soup
programme.desc: What does it take for everyday hawker stalls to earn Michelin recognition, and can they keep their Bib Gourmand status? How has the accolade impacted the life of these humble hawkers? At Bahrakath Mutton Soup, sole chef Syed Abdul Rahaman grapples with passing down this award-winning taste to his sons as age creeps up on him. Over at Selamat Datang Warong Pak Sapari, second-generation owner Sumadi Sapari walks the tightrope between expanding the business and protecting the authenticity of his late father's recipe. For Koh Brother Pig Organ Soup, Thomas Koh left his career to carry on a family legacy. After failed franchising attempts, he's poured himself into making every bowl the best it can be. And at Chef Kang's Noodle House, brothers Benson and Winson Moo—disciples of Michelin-starred Chef Kang—have won, lost, and regained their Bib Gourmand. This year, the question looms: can they hold onto it?

programme.title: Jockey Boy
programme.desc: Dao, a young jockey, has raced horses since he was five to support his struggling family. When his baby brother Fatih is born, Dao is sent to live with a horse owner, where he works and studies by dim stable light, dreaming of becoming a vet. After witnessing a rider fall during training, Dao is gripped by fear. His father takes him to a shaman, who blesses him and promises he’ll be safe. But Dao is troubled by talk of Fatih becoming a jockey too. On race day, standing at the starting line, Dao carries both hope and worry. How long can he keep racing—and at what cost to himself and his family?

programme.title: On The Red Dot
programme.sub-title: I Am A Hawker: Bib Gourmand Edition (Ep3): Koh Brother Pig’s Organ Soup
programme.desc: What does it take for everyday hawker stalls to earn Michelin recognition, and can they keep their Bib Gourmand status? How has the accolade impacted the life of these humble hawkers? At Bahrakath Mutton Soup, sole chef Syed Abdul Rahaman grapples with passing down this award-winning taste to his sons as age creeps up on him. Over at Selamat Datang Warong Pak Sapari, second-generation owner Sumadi Sapari walks the tightrope between expanding the business and protecting the authenticity of his late father's recipe. For Koh Brother Pig Organ Soup, Thomas Koh left his career to carry on a family legacy. After failed franchising attempts, he's poured himself into making every bowl the best it can be. And at Chef Kang's Noodle House, brothers Benson and Winson Moo—disciples of Michelin-starred Chef Kang—have won, lost, and regained their Bib Gourmand. This year, the question looms: can they hold onto it?
